summary: A great daily in the making: famous cities with Kinshasa and Lima as fun surprises, and a superb Blitz. Fix the junk aliases and Hong Kong first.
reasons: Casual found 8/10 quickly, then lost lives on true near misses (Dhaka #11, Bangkok #13) and on the city-proper rule (Paris #50, Manila #57, Buenos Aires #28).
'Delhi' is the classic trap: it offers Delhi / New Delhi, and both cost a life, since New Delhi proper is only #149. Correct, but it will sting.
Every capital scores in Blitz; a casual player named 30 in 90 seconds and all 30 scored.
fixes: Hong Kong is ranked #17 but is not a national capital; drop it from the ranking (and from Blitz scoring).

Drop junk aliases from Tokyo: 'Tokyo Plain', 'Jūjō, Tokyo' and 'Tokyo in pop culture'.
